note: Canonical note for a book (volume) in the series. Scenes link here via their `book` field; the reference panel can surface book metadata alongside scene context.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Fixed classifier — always `book`. Set by the template; do not change it.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Text. The book's canonical short name — used in `[[wikilinks]]` from scene notes. Should match the note title.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Text. The full published title of the book.

fields.name: subtitle
fields.description: Text. The subtitle, if any (e.g. "A Tale of the Forge").

fields.name: author
fields.description: Text. Author name(s) as they will appear on the cover.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Number. The book's position in the series reading order (1 = first). Used to sort book notes and scenes by volume.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Select — one of `planning | drafting | revising | done`. Current production state of the book.

fields.name: series
fields.description: Text. The series this book belongs to.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: List. Always includes `planning/book` — how views and Bases select book notes.
